description.value:
While a target is bonded, whenever it would take damage you may take any amount of that damage yourself instead. This requires no action and has no frequency limit.

  • Damage taken this way applies your own immunities, resistances, and weaknesses rather than the target's.
  • The bond is suspended while a target is further than 60 feet from you, and ends entirely if you fall unconscious.

From 5th level, bonded allies gain your resistances and immunities while within the bond's range. From 10th, the range is 120 feet, a spell you cast on a single creature that does not heal, damage or impose a condition affects every bonded ally too, and a 2-action healing spell on a single bonded ally costs 1 action and ignores range. From 15th, you may take a condition a bonded ally would gain, and bonded allies cannot be reduced below 1 Hit Point while you are conscious and above 0.

Apply Lifeline: Bonded to each ally you bond. When one takes damage, reduce the number applied to them and apply the rest to yourself.
